title: Evaluation and characterization of typical imaging findings of hematopoietic islands.
summary: Hematopoietic islands of the axial skeleton are very rare and can easily be confused with osteoblastic metastases. Typical MRI and CT morphologic criteria of this entity will be retrospectively studied.
conditions: Disease of blood and blood-forming organs, unspecified

interventions.name: Patients with MRI and CT scan of the axial skeleton initially and after a follow-up interval ≥ 6 months or histologically confirmed lesion.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
MRI and CT scan of the axial skeleton initially and after a follow-up interval ≥ 6 months or histologically confirmed lesion.
Exclusion criteria:
Incomplete examination data
No follow-up available or lack of histological confirmation
